notes:
Much faster opening of large models and smoother views with many objects.

### Improved
- Large projects open several times faster: a model with 2000 solids now opens and displays in well under 20 seconds instead of about two minutes. The displayed geometry is exactly the same.
- Saving large models for the first time is faster.
- Views with many objects redraw about 28% faster, with an identical image.
- Building display meshes is faster for every model.

### Fixed
- Extrude no longer shows the Cap option for a moment on open profiles.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
